note: Owner-declared level of pending private-fund capital calls (待 CALL 款), USD, for the v2.2 ABC comparison pool: pool = IB-HK official daily NAV + NOAH-HK cash balance − pending calls. Each entry states the level in force from its date onward; the latest entry dated on or before a day is that day's level. Append-only: never edit or delete a recorded entry; a correction is a new entry. A change of level is a boundary adjustment of the pool (scope-in when the level falls, scope-out when it rises) and never a return. Paying a call reduces NOAH-HK cash and the level by the same amount, so the pool does not move; declare the new level with the payment date.
